Title: Why does your partner keep waking you up for snoring? 3 foods making it worse

Description:
If your partner keeps elbowing you awake because you're snoring like a chainsaw, before you blame your age, check what you ate before bed.

Snoring happens when your airway narrows during sleep and the soft tissue around it vibrates as air squeezes through. Processed meats like bacon and deli cold cuts, sugary drinks like soda, and spicy, greasy takeout like hot wings can each narrow that airway in a different way — through sodium and swelling, weight gain, or acid reflux.

Watch to see why each one matters, and what to swap in instead.
